rules:
- id: "vuln-aiohttp-1c335944"
  pattern: |
    filepath = self._directory.joinpath(filename).resolve()
    if not self._follow_symlinks:
  pattern-not: |
    filepath = self._directory.joinpath(filename).resolve()
    if self._follow_symlinks:
  languages: ["python"]
  message: "Potential directory traversal vulnerability detected in aiohttp's static file serving. If `follow_symlinks` is set to False, it may allow an attacker to access files outside the specified directory through directory traversal attacks."
  severity: ERROR
  metadata:
    category: security
    cwe: CWE-352
    owasp: A1:2021-XML External Entities (XXE)
    references:
      - https://github.com/aio-libs/aiohttp/issues/4666
      - https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/352.html
    technology: ["python"]
